card.name: Inside ALL-CAPS label text
card.fires_on: Words or word parts inside long stretches of ALL-CAPS text, such as warning or section headings in drug labels. It fires partway through a capitalized word or on small linking words in capitals.

modes.label: Split capitalized words
modes.description: Fires on a middle piece of a long capitalized word, including spaced-out or misspelled headings.

modes.label: Linking words in capitals
modes.description: Fires on short capitalized words like OF, LONG or NON within an all-caps warning sentence.
modes.example: A MEASUREMENT<< OF>> HEMATOLOGICAL PARAMETERS WHERE APP

card.writes: The suppressed tokens are foreign-language adult words and the promoted ones are scattered capitalized fragments, so the output effect is unclear.
card.plain: It activates in the middle of words within shouted all-capital label text, such as warning headings.
